title: plugin-security cascade-delete parity test case 4 is flaky: its hook count filters ids by a two-character prefix that generated ids can carry
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kgF3mo9f7LXuv5hac

Filing gate: ① (named location, measured red on CI).

**Where:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/cascade-delete-security-parity.test.ts`, case "4. each child's delete-side work runs once per child > one audit delete row, every share revoked, and each object-less hook phase once, per child, a child two relations reach included" (the object-less hook count, around line 371, filters with `s.id.startsWith('h1')`).

**Measured:** CI `Test Core (8/8)` on PR #34358 head d4ea9c4d (job 133332217883, run 43876410651): `objectLessBefore` received one extra key `h1katWpkF0jVGL2s`. Object-less hooks also see deletes of rows with generated 16-character ids (audit and share rows), so a generated id that happens to start with `h1` is counted. PR #34358 touches no plugin-security, objectql or audit file and no delete path.

**Ask:** use a prefix generated ids cannot carry (one with an underscore), or filter on the exact known child ids, so the count is deterministic.

**Business reason:** a chance collision (about 1 in 3,800 per generated id) reds Test Core on unrelated PRs and costs a re-run each time.

**Reader who acts:** the owner of plugin-security tests; triage first-touches domain and grade.

**Dedupe:** searched open issues for "cascade-delete-security-parity", "startsWith prefix flaky": none.
